clauses.source: doc_030 'When a customer reports a lost or stolen debit card: 1) Complete the standard debit card freeze/close procedure 2) Check if the customer has any Rho-Bank credit cards' -> the freeze/close comes before the check.

clauses.clause: A card whose closure was blocked but that is frozen counts as handled
clauses.source: doc_030 step 1 names a 'freeze/close procedure' -> a freeze satisfies it; doc_026 'FREEZE: Temporary lock'.

clauses.clause: run this job once for the customer, not once per debit card
clauses.source: doc_030 'Check if the customer has any Rho-Bank credit cards on file'; get_credit_card_accounts_by_user takes only user_id -> the result is the same for every debit card, so one run covers them.

already_run.why: The check is customer-level, so repeating it adds nothing, and a second order would meet a pending request.

rewrite.do: If an activation call returns an error, act on what it names. 'Wrong activation tool': check issue_reason, unlock the tool the error names, and call it with the same details. 'Card verification failed': count it as an incorrect card-details attempt; ask once more, and after 2 incorrect attempts tell the customer the card is locked and they must visit a branch in person, then stop. A PIN error: ask for a new PIN that is exactly 4 digits and not sequential or repeating, then retry. A CVV or last-4-digits format error: ask the customer for that detail again, then retry. 'already active', 'Only PENDING cards can be activated' or 'no longer open': explain that the card cannot be activated and why, and stop. Any other error: explain it to the customer.
